titulo: Zelenskyy to present Ukraine’s case to UN general assembly – live
cuerpo: Second day of UNGA in New York will feature speeches by European leaders, while Trump and Xi will meet later There was also lots of focus on UK prime minister Andy Burnham’s first UN speech, late at night in Europe. In his speech, Burnham was keen to speak about how “Britain is back” after 10 years of Brexit, “restoring our stability” and “building a more dynamic economy.” “ Unlike Russia, we do not seek confrontation. Instead, we will be prepared, but not panicked. Clear-eyed, but cool headed. And unflinching in defending our people and our allies.” Continue reading...
